text: ekaṃ samayaṃ aññataro bhikkhu kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe . tena kho pana samayena so bhikkhu divāvihāragato pāpake akusale vitakke vitakketi seyyathīdaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ byāpādavitakkaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ . [790] atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā tassa bhikkhuno anukampikā atthakāmā taṃ bhikkhuṃ saṃvejetukāmā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi #1 nādīyasītipi pāṭhena bhavitabbaṃ . ayoniso manasikārā so 1 vitakkehi khajjasi 2 ayoniso paṭinissajja yoniso anuvicintaya satthāraṃ dhammaṃ ārabbha saṅghaṃ sīlāni vattano adhigacchasi pāmojjaṃ pītisukhamasaṃsayaṃ tato pāmujjabahulo 3 dukkhassantaṃ karissasīti . atha kho so bhikkhu tāya devatāya saṃvejito saṃvegamāpādīti . dvādasamaṃ
